selection.age_metallicity_distance: Not fitted or assumed in this spatially independent empirical sequence.
selection.extinction: Original DR9 per-object MW transmission for colors/magnitudes; median g/r transmission for the fine pixel depth mask.
selection.mask_and_depth_source: Published DR9 south coadd maskbits, nexp-g/r and PSF depth maps; no source remeasurement.
selection.scope: Train, training background, target and evaluation background are spatially disjoint. No motion or QSO result used to select CMD. Effective area is mask+depth grid quadrature, not image-level extraction completeness.

scope: Fixed old photometric cohort and separately frozen spatially independent deep template.
